cohort: 219 women with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) in France and 154 women with PAS in the UK
finding: The UK and France have different approaches to managing placenta accreta spectrum, with more women in France receiving a uterine-conserving approach and more women in the UK undergoing caesarean hysterectomy, resulting in higher rates of severe postpartum hemorrhage in the UK.
mod_finding: The management of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) differed between the UK and France, with the UK favoring cesarean hysterectomy and France using more uterine-conserving approaches, leading to higher rates of severe hemorrhage in the UK.
